verdict.rationale: Omarchy installs on your own machine from a USB ISO with a short guided setup, and it supports dual-booting beside Windows, unattended installs and trial in a VM. Graphics drivers, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are configured during install, and community users report an uncomplicated install on their own laptops using standard Arch package mirrors. Missing for 10: a documented hardware compatibility list or explicit statement of hardware breadth (NVIDIA is limited to 'supported hardware'), an explicit first-party statement on openness/no vendor lock-in, and independent reports across varied hardware.
